clues.text: Launching riders up to a top speed of 60 mph, this steel coaster towers 140 feet in the air and flips passengers upside down 4 times.
This coaster officially made its debut in 2015, crafted by acclaimed Swiss manufacturer Bolliger & Mabillard.
This high-flying ride is located in the holiday-themed park found in Santa Claus, Indiana.
This groundbreaking ride made history as the very first coaster built by Bolliger & Mabillard to utilize an LSM launch system.
The ride is named after a legendary avian creature from Indigenous folklore, famous for producing storms and lightning with its powerful wings.

evidence.quote: Thunderbird is a steel roller coaster located in the Thanksgiving section of Holiday World & Splashin' Safari in Santa Claus, Indiana.
Thunderbird was the first Bolliger & Mabillard coaster to utilize an LSM launch.
The designers took the Thunderbird name and coaster design and created a visual theme of the legendary bird's powerful flight through farms and forests of southern Indiana.
